newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen up after new record Dow close.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen up after new record Dow close.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to open higher on Tuesday following through on a rally which took the Dow industrials to a new record close on Monday.
Analysts said that the industrials, which closed at 7,079.39 could easily make a run for the 7,100 level today, but whether they close above it is another question..

"The momentum is there. We are only 21 points away. But after the morning followthrough, you are going to have watch the final hours of trading to see what happens," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments, said stocks would get a boost from a stable bond market and strong markets overseas.

"We will probably open higher. The rally yesterday showed that technical strength in the market remains unabated," he said. "I would think there is a good possibility that we test the 7,100 level and a good chance that we close above it."

The Dow could get a lift from Boeing Co, he said. Boeing is negotiating with Delta Air Lines Inc to obtain an exclusive supply agreement, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Tuesday.
